announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of a general meeting, which typically involves routine governance matters such as director reappointments or fee approvals. It signifies standard shareholder engagement rather than any material change to the company's strategic direction or financial position.

announcements.headline: Annual Financial Report
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled annual financial results, which typically provide shareholders with a comprehensive review of the company's performance and position over the past year.
